purpose: Official open-source LLVM/Clang + LLD toolchain for locally cross-building 3ds2apple GamePack arm64/x86_64 Mach-O dylibs on Windows/Linux without Apple SDK files.

license.notes: LLVM release binaries, clang, ld64.lld, llvm-ar, llvm-nm and llvm-objdump are redistributable under the LLVM licence with the licence text and copyright notices; keep the official files unmodified and pin SHA-256 (same policy as third_party/impactor).

assets.installer: NSIS; default install C:\Program Files\LLVM; winget id LLVM.LLVM

assets.note: 32-bit x86 Windows only; not needed for a 64-bit launcher
Checked 2026-11-14 against the GitHub release API digest field (not downloaded in full on the prototype host).

ubuntu_packages_prototype.install: tools/winbuild/fetch-llvm-ubuntu.sh (apt-get download + dpkg-deb -x, no root; every .deb verified against apt's published SHA512)
ubuntu_packages_prototype.verified_on: 2026-11-14, x86_64 WSL2, used for the prototype builds in docs/windows-build.md

host_tool_requirements.windows: Windows 10/11 x64; no Visual Studio, no Windows SDK, no Xcode, no Apple files
host_tool_requirements.linux: Ubuntu 22.04+/WSL2 or any glibc distro that runs the official LLVM tarball
host_tool_requirements.windows_posix_shell: Git for Windows (bundled MinGit is enough) for tools/winbuild/build-gamepack.sh; the build also works with a native C#/PowerShell invocation using the exact clang.exe/ld64.lld.exe command lines documented in tools/winbuild/README.md
host_tool_requirements.python: Python 3.8+ for tools/winbuild/check-gamepack.py (the Windows launcher already bundles a Python runtime for its build pipeline; without Python the script falls back to llvm-nm/llvm-objdump checks)

apple_sdk.reason: The generated C is compiled -nostdinc against tools/winbuild/darwin-stubs/include (hand-written ISO C declarations); libSystem/host symbols stay undefined via -undefined dynamic_lookup and resolve from the signed app + libSystem when the shell dlopen()s the pack. No Apple SDK header, stub library, tbd or binary is copied or redistributed.

validation.checks: thin 64-bit Mach-O dylib; arch matches target; LC_BUILD_VERSION platform ios/iossimulator minos >= 16.0; install name @rpath/GamePack-<TITLE>.dylib; exports zk_gamepack_title_id/abi_version/register + the seven recomp tables; keeps zk_register_gamepack undefined; defines no Zakuro runtime symbol; reports unexpected undefined imports
